messages.content:
You translate a traveller's one-day trip request in Singapore into a Python program that uses the z3
solver (`import z3`) to find a schedule satisfying EVERY requirement, or prove that none exists.

Facts (times in minutes since midnight, e.g. 09:00 = 540; money in whole SGD):
Places (id | name | cost | typical duration | open-close | showtimes):
siloso_beach | Siloso Beach | 0 | 90 | 07:00-22:00 | -
skyhelix | SkyHelix Sentosa | 20 | 30 | 10:00-21:30 | -
haw_par_villa | Haw Par Villa | 0 | 90 | 09:00-20:00 | -
chinatown_complex | Chinatown Complex Food Centre | 8 | 45 | 07:00-22:00 | -
adventure_cove | Adventure Cove Waterpark | 40 | 180 | 10:00-17:00 | -
universal_studios | Universal Studios Singapore | 83 | 480 | 10:00-19:00 | -
national_gallery | National Gallery Singapore | 25 | 150 | 10:00-19:00 | -
artscience | ArtScience Museum | 30 | 90 | 10:00-19:00 | -
singapore_zoo | Singapore Zoo | 49 | 240 | 08:30-18:00 | -
Travel times in minutes between places (row -> column):
siloso_beach: skyhelix 12, haw_par_villa 22, chinatown_complex 22, adventure_cove 12, universal_studios 13, national_gallery 25, artscience 26, singapore_zoo 51
skyhelix: siloso_beach 12, haw_par_villa 23, chinatown_complex 20, adventure_cove 11, universal_studios 12, national_gallery 23, artscience 24, singapore_zoo 51
haw_par_villa: siloso_beach 22, skyhelix 23, chinatown_complex 27, adventure_cove 22, universal_studios 24, national_gallery 29, artscience 31, singapore_zoo 43
chinatown_complex: siloso_beach 22, skyhelix 20, haw_par_villa 27, adventure_cove 20, universal_studios 20, national_gallery 14, artscience 15, singapore_zoo 46
adventure_cove: siloso_beach 12, skyhelix 11, haw_par_villa 22, chinatown_complex 20, universal_studios 12, national_gallery 23, artscience 24, singapore_zoo 50
universal_studios: siloso_beach 13, skyhelix 12, haw_par_villa 24, chinatown_complex 20, adventure_cove 12, national_gallery 23, artscience 23, singapore_zoo 51
national_gallery: siloso_beach 25, skyhelix 23, haw_par_villa 29, chinatown_complex 14, adventure_cove 23, universal_studios 23, artscience 13, singapore_zoo 45
artscience: siloso_beach 26, skyhelix 24, haw_par_villa 31, chinatown_complex 15, adventure_cove 24, universal_studios 23, national_gallery 13, singapore_zoo 47
singapore_zoo: siloso_beach 51, skyhelix 51, haw_par_villa 43, chinatown_complex 46, adventure_cove 50, universal_studios 51, national_gallery 45, artscience 47

Rules of the domain: a visit lasts exactly its duration (the typical one unless the traveller gives one); it must
lie within opening hours; a show may only start at one of its showtimes; visits cannot overlap and consecutive
visits need the travel time between them; must-visit places are required, optional ones may be skipped;
budget is the sum of costs of visited places.

Contract: output ONE python code block. When run, the program must print exactly one final line:
either the word UNSAT, or a JSON list of objects {"location_id": id, "start": minutes, "end": minutes}
for the visited places. Do not read input, do not use the network, do not print anything after that line.

Example of the output format only: [{"location_id": "museum", "start": 540, "end": 660}]

My day out runs from 09:00 until 17:05. My budget is S$4. I want to visit Siloso Beach, Haw Par Villa and Chinatown Complex Food Centre. If there's time, I'd also like SkyHelix Sentosa, Adventure Cove Waterpark, Universal Studios Singapore, National Gallery Singapore, ArtScience Museum and Singapore Zoo. I'd like to spend 75 minutes at Chinatown Complex Food Centre. I'd like to spend 210 minutes at Adventure Cove Waterpark.

response:
```python
import json
from z3 import *

# Create Z3 solver
s = Solver()

# Define locations and their properties
# (id, name, cost, default_duration, open_start, open_end)
places = {
    "siloso_beach": {"cost": 0, "dur": 90, "open": 420, "close": 1320},
    "skyhelix": {"cost": 20, "dur": 30, "open": 600, "close": 1290},
    "haw_par_villa": {"cost": 0, "dur": 90, "open": 540, "close": 1200},
    "chinatown_complex": {"cost": 8, "dur": 45, "open": 420, "close": 1320},
    "adventure_cove": {"cost": 40, "dur": 180, "open": 600, "close": 1020},
    "universal_studios": {"cost": 83, "dur": 480, "open": 600, "close": 1140},
    "national_gallery": {"cost": 25, "dur": 150, "open": 600, "close": 1140},
    "artscience": {"cost": 30, "dur": 90, "open": 600, "close": 1140},
    "singapore_zoo": {"cost": 49, "dur": 240, "open": 510, "close": 1080},
}

# Custom durations
durations = {
    "chinatown_complex": 75,
    "adventure_cove": 210,
}

# Travel times matrix
travel_times = {
    "siloso_beach": {"siloso_beach": 0, "skyhelix": 12, "haw_par_villa": 22, "chinatown_complex": 22, "adventure_cove": 12, "universal_studios": 13, "national_gallery": 25, "artscience": 26, "singapore_zoo": 51},
    "skyhelix": {"siloso_beach": 12, "skyhelix": 0, "haw_par_villa": 23, "chinatown_complex": 20, "adventure_cove": 11, "universal_studios": 12, "national_gallery": 23, "artscience": 24, "singapore_zoo": 51},
    "haw_par_villa": {"siloso_beach": 22, "skyhelix": 23, "haw_par_villa": 0, "chinatown_complex": 27, "adventure_cove": 22, "universal_studios": 24, "national_gallery": 29, "artscience": 31, "singapore_zoo": 43},
    "chinatown_complex": {"siloso_beach": 22, "skyhelix": 20, "haw_par_villa": 27, "chinatown_complex": 0, "adventure_cove": 20, "universal_studios": 20, "national_gallery": 14, "artscience": 15, "singapore_zoo": 46},
    "adventure_cove": {"siloso_beach": 12, "skyhelix": 11, "haw_par_villa": 22, "chinatown_complex": 20, "adventure_cove": 0, "universal_studios": 12, "national_gallery": 23, "artscience": 24, "singapore_zoo": 50},
    "universal_studios": {"siloso_beach": 13, "skyhelix": 12, "haw_par_villa": 24, "chinatown_complex": 20, "adventure_cove": 12, "universal_studios": 0, "national_gallery": 23, "artscience": 23, "singapore_zoo": 51},
    "national_gallery": {"siloso_beach": 25, "skyhelix": 23, "haw_par_villa": 29, "chinatown_complex": 14, "adventure_cove": 23, "universal_studios": 23, "national_gallery": 0, "artscience": 13, "singapore_zoo": 45},
    "artscience": {"siloso_beach": 26, "skyhelix": 24, "haw_par_villa": 31, "chinatown_complex": 15, "adventure_cove": 24, "universal_studios": 23, "national_gallery": 13, "artscience": 0, "singapore_zoo": 47},
    "singapore_zoo": {"siloso_beach": 51, "skyhelix": 51, "haw_par_villa": 43, "chinatown_complex": 46, "adventure_cove": 50, "universal_studios": 51, "national_gallery": 45, "artscience": 47, "singapore_zoo": 0},
}

# Day constraints
DAY_START = 540  # 09:00
DAY_END = 1025   # 17:05
BUDGET = 4

# Mandatory and optional
mandatory = ["siloso_beach", "haw_par_villa", "chinatown_complex"]
optional = ["skyhelix", "adventure_cove", "universal_studios", "national_gallery", "artscience", "singapore_zoo"]
all_places = list(places.keys())

# Variables
visited = {p: Bool(f"visited_{p}") for p in all_places}
start_time = {p: Int(f"start_{p}") for p in all_places}
end_time = {p: Int(f"end_{p}") for p in all_places}

# Mandatory visits must happen
for p in mandatory:
    s.add(visited[p] == True)

# Budget constraint
total_cost = Sum([If(visited[p], places[p]["cost"], 0) for p in all_places])
s.add(total_cost <= BUDGET)

# Time bounds and open/close constraints
for p in all_places:
    dur = durations.get(p, places[p]["dur"])
    # If visited
    s.add(Implies(visited[p], And(
        start_time[p] >= places[p]["open"],
        end_time[p] <= places[p]["close"],
        start_time[p] >= DAY_START,
        end_time[p] <= DAY_END,
        end_time[p] == start_time[p] + dur
    )))
    # If not visited, set times to 0 for cleanliness
    s.add(Implies(Not(visited[p]), And(start_time[p] == 0, end_time[p] == 0)))

# No overlap and travel time constraints between any two visited places p1 and p2
for p1 in all_places:
    for p2 in all_places:
        if p1 != p2:
            tt = travel_times[p1][p2]
            # If both visited, either p1 finishes + travel <= p2_start OR p2 finishes + travel <= p1_start
            s.add(Implies(
                And(visited[p1], visited[p2]),
                Or(
                    end_time[p1] + tt <= start_time[p2],
                    end_time[p2] + tt <= start_time[p1]
                )
            ))

# Solve
if s.check() == sat:
    m = s.model()
    result = []
    for p in all_places:
        if is_true(m[visited[p]]):
            result.append({
                "location_id": p,
                "start": m[start_time[p]].as_long(),
                "end": m[end_time[p]].as_long()
            })
    # Sort result by start time
    result.sort(key=lambda x: x["start"])
    print(json.dumps(result))
else:
    print("UNSAT")
```
